merged_why: 118 mutants at ~38.5s each on an 83,754-case corpus is 4,540s against the 600s a foreground command may block for, so the sweep is thirteen parts. Nine are operator-filtered whole; index_offset, arith_op and swap_operands are two SLICES each and const_tweak is four, because vit_mutate.py --offset/--limit names a window and this merge checks that the windows of the parts sharing an operator PARTITION it by mutant id. All thirteen were re-run at the fourth dispatch on the corpus the CntrPar_IPC_IntSat pin produces, with --equivalences and --unreachable supplied to every one.
